itineraries.title: Five days in the Gulf of Fethiye
itineraries.intro: Göcek’s twelve islands: pine-fringed, current-free and made for a first family charter.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Göcek to Göcek
itineraries.intro: Ocean Independence’s classic Lycian week: Fethiye, Ölüdeniz, Ekincik and the islands.

days.note: Board in Göcek; the first anchorage among the pine-clad islands of the gulf.
The blue lagoon and Butterfly Valley.
The old shipyard island and its Byzantine ruins; a swim in the inner bay.
